name: Airline Cemetery
description: Airline Cemetery, also known as Airline Baptist Church Cemetery, is located near Mayo in Lafayette County, Florida.

name: Arabia Cemetery
description: Arabia Cemetery, also known as Bethany Church Cemetery, is located on Arabia Church Road near Homerville in Clinch County, Georgia. The cemetery serves as a burial ground for families from the surrounding community.

name: Bell's Mill Creek (Bethel Creek Baptist Church) Cemetery
description: Historically known as Bell's Mill Creek Cemetery, this burial ground is associated with Bethel Creek Baptist Church near Day, Florida. The cemetery predates the present church, with some gravestones dating to 1868. The current church was organized in 1949.

burials.name: Deloris Herrin Morgan
burials.note: Grandaunt — Living — named on shared gravestone with Royce Leaton Morgan; not a confirmed burial.

name: Bethany Cemetery
description: Bethany Cemetery is located in Lafayette County, Florida. The cemetery contains burials associated with the Singletary and Ducksworth families.

name: Brady Cemetery
description: Brady Cemetery is a historic burial ground located west of Lee in Madison County, Florida. The cemetery contains graves of several generations of local families, including members of the Wadsworth and Darling families.

name: Day Cemetery
description: Day Cemetery is located in Day, Lafayette County, Florida. The cemetery includes members of the Bell, Shiver, and Singletary families.

name: Guest Mill Pond (Lang Country Church) Cemetery
description: Guest Mill Pond Cemetery, also known as Langs Church Cemetery, is a historic burial ground in Clinch County, Georgia. The cemetery is associated with the former Guest Mill Pond community, an early settlement that included a grist mill, cotton gin, trading post, and local election precinct.
The cemetery lies near the Clinch-Atkinson county line and is associated with both Homerville and Pearson in published location records

name: Hargraves Chapel Cemetery
description: Hargraves Chapel Cemetery is a historic burial ground in Ware County, Georgia, associated with the Millwood community. The cemetery contains graves of members of the Hargraves, Bennett, Herrin, and other local families.

name: Indian Mound Baptist Church Cemetery
description: Indian Mound Cemetery, also known as Indian Mound Baptist Church Cemetery, is located on Indian Mound Road near Millwood in Ware County, Georgia. The cemetery is associated with the Indian Mound Baptist Church community.

name: Midway Cemetery
description: Midway Cemetery, also known as Midway Baptist Church Cemetery, is located near Mayo in Lafayette County, Florida.

name: Mount Olive Cemetery
description: Mount Olive Cemetery is located near Lee in Madison County, Florida. The cemetery is a burial ground for families from the surrounding communities, including members of the Matthews and Barker families.

name: Old Town Memorial Cemetery
description: Old Town Memorial Cemetery, also known as Old Town Cemetery, is located in Old Town in Dixie County, Florida. The cemetery serves as a burial ground for generations of families from Old Town and the surrounding communities.

name: Red Bluff Cemetery
description: Red Bluff Cemetery, also known as Red Bluff Primitive Baptist Church Cemetery, is located southeast of Pearson in Atkinson County, Georgia. It contains the graves of several generations of the Williams, Palmer, and related families.

name: Woodlawn Cemetery
description: Woodlawn Cemetery, also known as Perry City Cemetery, is located northeast of downtown Perry in Taylor County, Florida. The cemetery contains graves of generations of families from Perry and the surrounding communities.
